checkIntervalUnit.name: Periodic check unit
checkIntervalUnit.description: Unit of the periodic update check interval: disabled | hour | day | month. Disabled means checks only run on demand or on events (wake/network)

checkIntervalValue.name: Periodic check value
checkIntervalValue.description: Interval value combined with checkIntervalUnit (e.g. 2 + day = every 2 days)

autoUpdateEnabled.name: Auto apply updates
autoUpdateEnabled.description: Automatically apply updates found during periodic checks. Disabled by default. Even when enabled, any security advisory or pre-update check recommendation still requires your explicit confirmation

showSecurityAdvisory.name: Show security advisory
showSecurityAdvisory.description: Show security advisory banners and require confirmation before updating critical packages

fetchUpstreamAdvisories.name: Fetch upstream advisories
fetchUpstreamAdvisories.description: Fetch security notices from the upstream official advisory feeds of the distro/packages. Display only; on failure it silently falls back to local info and never blocks updates

preferredBackend.name: Preferred package backend
preferredBackend.description: Runtime override of preferred backend id (e.g. apt/dnf). Lower priority than backend.conf; empty = auto-detect by distro preset

noInstallRecommends.name: No install recommends
noInstallRecommends.description: Skip optional Recommends dependencies on install (APT)

autoRemoveOrphans.name: Auto remove orphans
autoRemoveOrphans.description: Run autoremove to purge orphan dependencies after operations

autoCleanCache.name: Auto clean cache
autoCleanCache.description: Clean downloaded package cache after operations
